policies.fixed: Same seeds TOWER1/2/3 and each preset. Equip two highest scored attacks, a heal, then best remaining card. Recruit at3; camp6/8; normal fights otherwise. Recruit rewards first, heal if party missing>=5HP, primary training, any training, first offered reward. New camp6 recruit offer is selected by this existing priority; old catalogue had no such offer.
policies.adaptive: TOWER3, all three presets. Preserve attacks of two different elements when available, value footprint size, draft a spell if it improves the weakest equipped slot. Choose recruit6 when missing<7HP, favor creature recruit on6. Otherwise same recovery and training priorities.
policies.coop: Three distinct starter pairings over TOWER1/2/3. AI plans allied team jointly; orders are partitioned by controller and both controllers consent to Link. Tests model cooperation, not human skill or network latency.

limitations: Small deterministic samples, not a human win-rate estimate.
Different outcomes and early losses change which later rooms enter unpaired averages. Matched-battle means are also reported.
Timing is local Windows Node under concurrent host load, not production edge runtime or mobile rendering performance.
All battle outcomes are actual resolver eliminations. No forced winners or edited battle states were used in these diagnostic runs.
Synthetic state changes are confined to separately labeled unit-test fixtures.

definitions.ordinary: All sampled rooms below floor 9 were ordinary combat rooms; elite rooms were not selected by these policies.
definitions.collapse: Collapse damage is the sum of actual collapse event amounts, not a timeout result. EndedWithCollapseDamage means the ending exchange contained at least one collapse damage event; it does not attribute the whole outcome to collapse.
definitions.winner: 0 = allied party survives; 1 = enemy party survives; draw = both parties eliminated in the same exchange. No clock/round winner is assigned.
definitions.sampling: Final v22 suites: 15 actual climbs, 78 battles. Old v21 comparison: 9 actual climbs, 49 battles. Adaptive suite repeats TOWER3 intentionally; these are not 15 independent seeds.
